name: Chirag Trivedi
bio: Chirag Trivedi is Assistant Professor in Communication at the Amrut Mody School of Management. He is pursuing PhD from Gujarat University with focus of his doctoral study on Elitism in Gujarati literature: A postcolonial inquiry into the shaping of the literary canon in Gujarat. He has been presenting and publishing research papers in national and international conferences and journals for the last 15 years.
